title: Chipotle Shrimp with Corn Cakes

ingredients.name: heaping Tbs canned chipotle in adobo sauce

steps.text: For chipotle butter, roughly puree together the softened butter and the chipotles. Set aside at room temperature.
For corn cakes, mix dry ingredients in a bowl. In a large bowl, whisk together buttermilk and butter, then whisk in egg.
Gradually add dry to wet ingredients, and whisk until thoroughly incorporated.
Puree 1/2 cup of corn and fold it into the batter. Add remaining 1/2 cup of whole corn kernels and scallions. Add a little buttermilk if necessary to thin mixture.

Cook corn cakes in a nonstick pan over medium heat. Form 3" cakes. Cook until golden brown (about 2.5 minutes on each side). Batter makes about 18-20 corn cakes. Can place cooked cakes on a baking sheet in a warmed oven to keep them warm.
For shrimp, cook on a griddle or frying pan on low-medium heat. Use 2 Tbs butter and/or oil. Cook about 1 minute per side.

To serve, Place 3 corn cakes on each plate. Place 5 shrimp on top of cakes and spread chipotle butter liberally over shrimp. Sprinkle chopped scallions over shrimp. Serve the Pico de Gallo salsa at side of corn cakes.

notes: Servings: 6 * if using powdered buttermilk, start with only 1 cup water ** Can use canned or frozen corn. Drain well. If making corn cakes ahead of time, do not refrigerate. Slightly undercook them, place on a cookie sheet, and warm in a 250 degree oven.
